# Units of ai-scientist-ideate

A Unit = one step plus its armour: it runs from frozen inputs alone, a tool decides whether it is done, and a
person can handle it without reading the other Units (docs/decisions/PLAN_ideate_armor.md §2). This file is
rendered from `scripts/ideate_units.json`; the rules themselves live where each card's `rules` points.

Blocks: **search** (A1–A5) · **fulltext** (A6.d, A6.c — references/scholar-pipeline.md §2) · **fusion** (A7, B1,
B2, B3, B3.5 — once per topic; references/fusion/) · planning (B4–B6 — once per idea). The planning block runs
as described in SKILL.md.

**Fields declared** = every card field of a level's conditions is filled in. **Achieved** = the level whose
conditions are all met, from each card's `achieved` block; `units check` refuses a `yes` that the
code or the shared armour does not back (a counter-example missing, or a ledger / replay / trace / override
entry that is not built). Built so far: ledger, status_view, replay, interrupt_harness, trace, overrides.

## Numbers the checks enforce

| Rule | Value (from the code) |
|---|---|
| flat query length (content words) | 3–5 |
| synonyms per search axis | quick ≥ 2, standard / deep ≥ 3 (warning above 8) |
| search axes per protocol | 2–4 |
| query variants by depth | quick: primary, synonym-swap, anchor-methods; standard: primary, synonym-swap, anchor-methods, loosen, contrast; deep: primary, synonym-swap, anchor-methods, loosen, contrast, counter-evidence, recent |
| axis kinds required by depth | quick: anchor; standard: anchor, contrast; deep: anchor, contrast, counter |
| protocol evaluation rounds | at most 2 (one forced revision) |
| frameworks | PICO (population, intervention, comparison, outcome), PICOC (population, intervention, comparison, outcome, context), PECO (population, exposure, comparator, outcome), PEO (population, exposure, outcome), PCC (population, concept, context), SPIDER (sample, phenomenon, design, evaluation, research_type), PICo (population, phenomenon, context), CIMO (context, intervention, mechanism, outcome), custom |
| sources | semantic_scholar, openalex, pubmed, arxiv, scopus, ieee, wos |
| records per source per query (A2.s) | 50 (dense D1: 50) |
| form each source gets (A2.s) | pubmed: boolean, scopus: boolean, ieee: boolean, wos: boolean, openalex: boolean-nostar, arxiv: arxiv, semantic_scholar: flat |
| routing by variant (A2.s) | recent: arxiv, openalex, semantic_scholar; others: every chosen source |
| on-anchor share below which a query cannot be ok (A2.c) | 50% |
| relevance rounds (A2.c) | at most 3 (two re-plan rounds) |
| saturation (A2.c) | a re-plan round adding < 5% new papers ends re-planning |
| composite (A3) | relevance × 0.50 + quality × 0.30 + impact × 0.20; included at >= 3.00 |
| impact (A3.b) | 0.7 × field-normalised citation percentile + 0.3 × in-collection citation percentile; venue percentile as a prior below 2 years (half), at 2 (a quarter); 1 + 4 × value |
| gate types (A3.g) | editorial, erratum, grant, letter, libguides, paratext, peer-review, reference-entry, retraction, supplementary-materials |
| batch size (A3) | 60 papers per subagent |
| bulk rules (A3) | relevance <= 2, only papers with no anchor term and sem_pct < 25 |
